claims.text: Cilostazol is not a substitute for risk-factor modification and exercise.
claims.quote: cilostazol is not a substitute for risk factor modification and exercise

claims.text: 100 mg PO BID, at least half an hour before or two hours after breakfast and dinner.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of cilostazol is 100 mg twice daily taken at least half an hour before or two hours after breakfast and dinner.

claims.text: 50 mg BID with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ketoconazole, erythromycin, diltiazem) or CYP2C19 inhibitors (eg, fluconazole, omeprazole).
claims.quote: Reduce dose to 50 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong or moderate inhibitors of CYP3A4 (e.g., ketoconazole, itraconazole, erythromycin, and diltiazem) or inhibitors of CYP2C19 (e.g., ticlopidine, fluconazole, and omeprazole)
claims.locator: 2.2 Dose Reduction with CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 Inhibitors
